tasks.description: Write packages/core/lib/conflict-classifier.js (classify, decide, stuckText, CLI main), add the packages/full/lib/ symlink and the .claude/lib/ copy. Acceptance: .claude/rules/x.md returns forbidden with stopNow; two list additions to a barrel return mechanical; two different edits of the same line return behavioural; .trd-state/a/implement.json returns record; decide stops a mechanical conflict at failedAttempts 2 with checksFailed true and not at 1; CLI prints one JSON line; core and .claude/lib copies diff empty; packages/full/lib copy is a symlink to core.

Write packages/core/lib/conflict-classifier.test.js covering each class, forbidden path forms, the feature's own TRD, every mechanical and behavioural rule, the two-attempt rule at 0, 1, 2, STUCK text for each stop, the CLI, mixed sets, the package.json comma case, path edge cases (absolute, escaping, renamed, symlink mode), isRecordFile called (mocked), the mirror, and pinned mutations. Acceptance: npx jest packages/core/lib/conflict-classifier.test.js packages/core/lib/record-files.test.js is green.

requirements.statement: A library packages/core/lib/conflict-classifier.js classifies a set of conflicted paths, each with the two sides' hunks, as exactly one of record, mechanical, behavioural or forbidden. Must pass: yes.
A path under .claude/rules/, or any file under docs/TRD/ other than the feature's own TRD, classifies forbidden however its hunks look, and never as a record file. Must pass: yes.

Both sides adding entries to a list, schema or barrel file, disjoint hunks in one region, and a test broken only by the base's changes classify mechanical; anything not placeable as mechanical (overlapping changes, same key with two values, missing hunks, deleted file) classifies behavioural. Must pass: yes.

Stop rules live in the library: forbidden and behavioural stop (forbidden at once); a mechanical conflict whose checks still fail after two failed fix attempts following a resolution becomes behavioural and stops. Must pass: yes.
The library produces STUCK text: a one-line Reason naming every file that forced the stop and the clash in each, and a Next line. Must pass: yes.

isRecordFile in packages/core/lib/record-files.js stays the single definition of a record file; the classifier calls it and defines no record path of its own; record-files.test.js still passes. Must pass: yes.
A one-JSON-line CLI (classify, decide, stuck) exists in the manner of merge-up.js; the library is mirrored to packages/full/lib/ (symlink) and .claude/lib/ (copy). Must pass: no.

classify({files, featureTrd}) returns {ok, class, stop, stopNow, files:[{path,class,reason,clash?}]} with precedence forbidden > behavioural > mechanical > record; stop true for forbidden and behavioural; empty or malformed input returns ok false with a reason.

Per-file order: forbidden path, then isRecordFile, then hunk rules. Hunk shape {base, ours, theirs}; optional oldPath, mode, deletedBy, binary, testBrokenByBase; a test with testBrokenByBase and no hunks is an entry with the flag and no hunks.

Forbidden paths normalised (./, .., doubled slashes, backslashes); .claude/rules prefix matched case-insensitively; everything under docs/TRD/ forbidden except featureTrd (exact, case-sensitive); no featureTrd means every TRD forbidden; absolute, drive-letter or escaping paths forbidden; oldPath checked; isForbidden(path, featureTrd) exported; isRecordFile receives the path unnormalised.

Mechanical rules (a) same-edit-to-last-entry with shared leading lines, (b) add-only list entries with no same-key or same-declaration clash, (c) edits to different base lines with no insertion beside a changed line, (d) test file with testBrokenByBase mechanical unless both sides changed the same base lines differently; each hunk must pass or the file is behavioural. Hunks over 500 lines per side, missing hunks, malformed hunks, deletedBy, binary and non-regular mode are behavioural; each reason has a stable code (overlap, same-key, no-hunks, deleted, non-regular, too-large, ...).

decide({classification, resolved, checksFailed, failedAttempts}) returns {action, effectiveClass, stop, escalated, reason}: forbidden stops at once; behavioural stops; record gives record-merge; mechanical gives resolve, commit, fix, or stop with effectiveClass behavioural and escalated true when checks failed and failedAttempts is 2 or more.

stuckText({classification, command, failedAttempts, lastFailure}) returns {reason, next, text}; text is '═══ COMMAND STUCK: <command> ═══' then Reason and Next lines; Reason is one line naming each stopping file with its clash (differing lines for overlap, key for clash, rule for forbidden, failing check for escalation).
CLI: node conflict-classifier.js classify|decide|stuck (--file <path> | --stdin), no --json flag; prints one JSON line and exits 0, including for bad usage (ok false).
conflict-classifier.js requires ./record-files for isRecordFile and contains no record-file path literal of its own; a test pins both.

open_questions: OQ-1: How does a caller show 'a test broken only by the base's changes'? Assumed: a testBrokenByBase flag measured by the caller (owner-only: no). OQ-2: Is an insertion beside a line the other side changed mechanical? Assumed: no, behavioural (owner-only: no).
